title: Build a Character Counter (textarea with limit)
description: A textarea that shows characters used and remaining, warns near the limit and blocks submit past it.

title: Build a Mortgage Calculator
description: Inputs for loan amount, interest rate and term that compute the monthly payment, total paid and total interest.

title: Build a Generate Table (rows x columns)
description: A form takes a row and column count and renders a table whose numbers snake down and up the columns.

title: Build a Show/Hide Password Input
description: A password field with a toggle button that reveals and hides the value, keeps focus and caret position, and is screen-reader friendly.

title: Build a Read More / Show Less text component
description: Truncate long text to a few lines or characters with a toggle that expands and collapses it.

title: Build a Countdown Timer
description: Enter minutes and seconds, then start, pause, resume and reset a countdown that stops at zero and announces completion.

title: Build Grid Lights
description: A 3x3 grid (centre cell empty) where clicked cells light up and, once all are lit, switch off one by one in reverse click order.

title: Build an Undoable Counter (undo/redo history)
description: A counter with +1/-1/+10/-10 buttons, a history log, and undo/redo that behaves correctly after a new action following an undo.

title: Build a Flight Booker
description: Choose one-way or return, pick dates, validate that the return is not before departure, and confirm the booking.

title: Build a Job Board (paginated fetch)
description: Load job IDs, fetch details in pages of six, show a Load more button, and handle loading and errors without duplicates.

title: Build a Signup Form with async username availability check
description: Validate fields as the user types and check username availability with a debounced request that ignores stale responses.

title: Build a Markdown Previewer
description: A textarea of markdown with a live preview for headings, bold, italics, links, lists and code, without injecting unsafe HTML.

title: Build a Selectable Cell Grid (drag to select)
description: Click and drag across a grid to select a rectangular block of cells, with the selection clearing on the next drag.

title: Build Wordle
description: Guess a five-letter word in six tries with per-letter feedback, an on-screen keyboard and correct handling of repeated letters.

title: Build Tic-Tac-Toe II (N x N board, M in a row)
description: Generalise tic-tac-toe to a configurable N x N board where M in a row wins, with an efficient win check and undo.

title: Build Minesweeper
description: A board with hidden mines, numbered cells, flood-fill reveal of empty areas, flags, a first-click-safe guarantee and win/lose states.

title: Build a Calendar Day View with overlapping events
description: Lay out timed events on a day grid so that overlapping events share the width in columns without hiding each other.

title: Build a data-fetching hook with caching, deduplication and retry
description: A reusable useQuery-style hook or composable that caches by key, shares one request between callers, retries with backoff and can be invalidated.

title: Build a Live Stock Ticker with throttled updates
description: Render a table of prices from a fast simulated WebSocket feed, batching updates per frame and flashing changed cells without dropping data.

title: Build @Mentions in a textarea
description: Typing @ opens a filtered user list at the caret, arrow keys and Enter insert the mention, and Escape or a space closes it.
